description: This Java class 'ScaleImage' provides methods to scale product images into multiple predefined sizes (small, medium, large, detail). It reads configuration from XML, processes images, saves scaled versions, and generates URLs for different image sizes within an OFBiz-based e-commerce system.

classes.name: ScaleImage
classes.description: A utility class for scaling product images into multiple sizes, reading configuration from XML, and managing image files and URLs within an OFBiz environment.

methods.name: scaleImageInAllSize
methods.description: Scales an image into small, medium, large, and detail sizes, returning URLs and image data.

methods.name: scaleImageManageInAllSize
methods.description: Manages scaling of images into specified sizes, with flexible filename and view type handling.

methods.name: scaleImage
methods.description: Performs scaling of a single image into multiple sizes based on configuration, saving files, and generating URLs.
